observations: Photo 0: Black rectangular console lying flat with a diagonal ridged top panel, a controller resting on top of it.
Photo 1: Side-by-side view of what appears to be the same or a second black console unit, 'XBOX' logo visible in the top right corner.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or game discs are visible in either photo.
Only one controller is visible, matching the seller's claim of 'one controller'.
No serial number, model sticker, or storage capacity label is visible in either photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAME VILLAGE' overlays both images, consistent with a listing site, not proof of condition.

identity.kind: Xbox One console with one controller

claims.evidence: No region sticker, plug type, or import marking visible in either photo.
Photo 0 shows a single controller resting on the console.
No game discs, cases, or digital library screen are shown in either photo.
No power-on photo or screen showing a booted dashboard.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common issue with used Xbox One units, e.g. disc drive or HDD failure).
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the console powered on showing the dashboard/home screen.

risks.risk: No power cable or HDMI cable shown, which are needed to use the console.
risks.proof: A photo showing the power brick, power cable, and HDMI cable included.

risks.risk: Claimed games (FC, GTA, MK) not visible, could be absent or only digital placeholders not transferable.
risks.proof: A photo of the physical discs/cases or a screenshot of the installed games library tied to the seller's account.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-controller only, no games

risks.risk: Exact Xbox variant (Xbox One, Xbox One S, Xbox One X) not confirmed, which affects value due to storage and performance differences.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear/bottom panel showing the model number sticker.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition beyond visible scuffs (e.g., disc drive wear, overheating marks, hinge issues) cannot be assessed from these angles.
risks.proof: Additional close-up photos of all sides, vents, and ports.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used with cosmetic wear

proof_requests: Photo/video of the console powered on, showing the dashboard.
Photo of the rear panel with the model/serial sticker visible.
Photo of the power cable, power brick, and HDMI cable included in the sale.
Photo of the actual game discs or a screenshot of the installed games list under the seller's profile.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an Xbox One console with one controller, but functionality, included games, and accessories are all unverified from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case until proof is given.
